scope: Agency/TEILEKLAR source-faithful rebuild; technical acceptance mapping, not certification or legal opinion

sources.authority: European Commission AI Act Service Desk
European Commission AI Act Service Desk

standards.title: DIN 5008
standards.edition_observation: DIN catalogue marks 2020-03 and correction 1:2020-07 current.
standards.applicability: Business correspondence/offers by repository requirement; not a general website visual style law.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Full applicable edition including correction needed before precise layout compliance; qualified document review.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: ISO 9241-210
standards.edition_observation: ISO 9241-210:2019; DIN EN edition 2020-03 marked current.
standards.applicability: Human-centred design process for actual users/tasks/context; project quality target, not aesthetic certification.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Full edition for clause-level conformity; real stakeholder/user evaluation.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: ISO 9241-11
standards.edition_observation: ISO 9241-11:2018; DIN EN edition 2018-11 marked current.
standards.applicability: Define and evaluate effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction in a specified usage context; do not invent acceptance percentages.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Full edition and agreed usage context; real participant study before usability claims.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: ISO 9001
standards.edition_observation: DIN catalogue: 2015-11 plus A1:2024-11 current; ISO 9001:2026/DIN edition 2026-11 labelled pre-provided. Edition/transition decision pending, not silently upgraded.
standards.applicability: Optional organisation-wide QMS target unless actual contracts impose it; repository CI alone is not a QMS.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Approved scope, licensed current edition and transition plan; independent certification body only if certification is sought.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: ISO/IEC 27001
standards.edition_observation: ISO/IEC 27001:2022; DIN EN 2024-01 and A1:2024-11 (Amd 1:2024) current in DIN catalogue.
standards.applicability: Optional scoped ISMS; security engineering and GDPR obligations apply independently.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Risk assessment and justified controls/SoA from applicable full standard; management and operational audit; certification independent if sought.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: WCAG 2.2 level AA
standards.edition_observation: W3C Recommendation 2024-12-12 read at dated stable URL.
standards.applicability: Mandatory repository accessibility target for complete public/private flows; automated checks cover only part of it.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Manual keyboard, assistive-technology and complete-process evaluation; no WCAG certificate inferred.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: EN 301 549
standards.edition_observation: DIN catalogue: EN V3.2.1(2021-03), DIN2022-06 current; prEN301549:2025/DIN2026-05 draft. ETSI full PDF blocked.
standards.applicability: Assess applicable web, documents, software, support/media requirements; not identical to WCAG2.2 and not automatic BFSG harmonisation proof.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Obtain publicly available official ETSI text through supported access; check current edition and current EU Official Journal references for the actual legal instrument.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: BFSG/BFSGV and European Accessibility Act
standards.edition_observation: BFSG scope includes services provided after 2025-06-28. BFSGV text read with amendment 2026-07-10.
standards.applicability: Conditional legal scope: actual B2C e-commerce/services, markets and provider role; microenterprise service exception cannot be assumed for this B.V.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Qualified legal applicability assessment; confirm relevant harmonised norms and accessibility information obligations; no automatic exemption from business name or size guess.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: GDPR Articles 25 and 32
standards.edition_observation: Regulation(EU)2016/679 reference; EUR-Lex body unavailable here. EDPB official security/design guidance read.
standards.applicability: Personal data in visitor chat, identities, bookings, outbox, voices/images: minimisation, safe defaults and risk-appropriate security; determine controller/processor roles.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Read current consolidated legal text in usable official form; documented processing/retention/transfer/incident decisions and operational evidence; assess DPIA necessity, do not assume it.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

standards.title: AI Act Article 50 and application Article 113
standards.edition_observation: EU Commission Service Desk article text states consolidated version as at 2026-07-27; Article113 general application 2026-08-02 with specific exceptions. EUR-Lex body unavailable here.
standards.applicability: Classify actual provider/deployer role, interaction and synthetic/deepfake media; accessible notice at relevant first interaction/exposure; not a blanket claim that every website is certified AI-compliant.
standards.independent_or_licensed_review: Qualified role/scope review and current official consolidated law; verify provider machine-readable output marking and presenter disclosure rights.
standards.public_text_review_scope: Targeted publicly available requirements/metadata only; no claim of complete clause-by-clause standard review.

requirements.requirement: Approved business document template with sender/recipient, date, subject, readable structure and edition-bound layout.
requirements.implementation_plan: Replace or extend the minimal PDF draft with an approved versioned template; retain draft status and existing price/legal gates. Do not invent DIN measurements without full text.
requirements.test_plan: Render short/long DE/NL/FR cases; inspect page breaks, address block, clipping and paper output against the licensed applicable edition.
requirements.gap: Current make_pdf produces real draft PDF but has no demonstrated DIN5008 template or layout acceptance.

requirements.requirement: PDF download preserves content and accessible reading alternatives.
requirements.implementation_plan: Provide an HTML/transcript alternative now; plan semantic/tagged PDF and document accessibility evaluation where applicable.
requirements.test_plan: Validate PDF text/order/language/structure with appropriate tool and manual reader; xref tests alone insufficient.
requirements.gap: PDF byte/xref/draft tests do not establish document accessibility or DIN conformity.

requirements.requirement: Define actual users, tasks and usage context before approving design.
requirements.implementation_plan: Document agency vs TEILEKLAR roles, public vs authenticated flows, devices, languages and assistive technology contexts without importing Affilinet users.
requirements.test_plan: Review explicit tasks and expected outcomes with product owner and representative users.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Preserve source intent while documenting design changes.
requirements.implementation_plan: Map every page/section/action to preserved source, native target and documented deviations; separate premium visual decisions from normative compliance.
requirements.test_plan: Compare source and target at agreed desktop/mobile states; record missing interactions and reviewer disposition.
requirements.gap: Source inventory is available but 93-source content/interaction acceptance remains incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Usability outcomes require real task evaluation.
requirements.implementation_plan: Agree task completion, effort/time/error and satisfaction measures and thresholds before study; include unsuccessful and interrupted flows.
requirements.test_plan: Observe representative participants and report sample/context/limitations; do not substitute screenshots or invented percentages.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Iterative design decisions are traceable to findings.
requirements.implementation_plan: Keep issue, proposed change, source relationship, user impact and retest record for each accepted iteration.
requirements.test_plan: Review one complete finding-to-retest trail and reopen unresolved high-impact findings.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Normal text contrast >=4.5:1; large text >=3:1; relevant nontext UI contrast >=3:1, subject to criterion applicability.
requirements.implementation_plan: Derive colors from approved tokens and verify actual foreground/background states including focus/errors/disabled exceptions.
requirements.test_plan: Compute contrast for all combinations and manually inspect images, gradients and states; map SC1.4.3/1.4.11.
requirements.gap: Token/heuristic audit is not a complete contrast inventory of rebuilt pages.

requirements.requirement: Keyboard access, meaningful focus order, no keyboard trap; focus visible and not obscured.
requirements.implementation_plan: Ensure navigation, mobile sidebar/dialog, close controls, forms and Clerk components work without pointer; restore focus after dismiss.
requirements.test_plan: Manual Tab/ShiftTab/Enter/Space/Escape across full flows; SC2.1.1/2.1.2/2.4.3/2.4.7/2.4.11.
requirements.gap: Existing focus code does not prove rebuilt page or provider-widget keyboard conformance.

requirements.requirement: Reflow and zoom preserve information and operation.
requirements.implementation_plan: Support 320 CSS-pixel equivalent width for relevant content and 200% text resize; document legitimate two-dimensional exceptions.
requirements.test_plan: Manual 400% browser zoom at 1280px and 200% text resize; mobile landscape and virtual keyboard; SC1.4.4/1.4.10.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Pointer target rule is accurate and repository target retained.
requirements.implementation_plan: WCAG2.2 AA SC2.5.8 uses24x24 CSS pixels or applicable spacing/exceptions; repository deliberately requires >=44px targets. Do not mislabel44px as the universal AA threshold.
requirements.test_plan: Measure rendered targets and spacing, touch hit areas and exceptions; test drag alternatives if introduced (SC2.5.7).
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Forms and auth provide accessible labels, errors and authentication.
requirements.implementation_plan: Use programmatic names/instructions, associate errors, preserve entered values, allow password manager/paste and avoid cognition-only barriers; review third-party login.
requirements.test_plan: Accessibility tree, keyboard and screen reader tests; SC1.3.1/3.3.1/3.3.2/3.3.7/3.3.8/4.1.2.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Asynchronous statuses are perceivable without false success.
requirements.implementation_plan: Announce pending/error states appropriately and distinguish draft/requested/pending/confirmed; avoid unnecessarily interruptive announcements.
requirements.test_plan: Inspect live regions with reader and real failed API responses; SC4.1.3 plus actual business status assertions.
requirements.gap: Existing status strings/HTTP tests do not establish all screen-reader announcements in rebuilt UI.

requirements.requirement: Media has appropriate captions, descriptions/alternatives and user control.
requirements.implementation_plan: For actual prerecorded media assess captions and audio-description requirements; provide transcript/alternative; no sound autoplay; pause/stop moving content; retain reduced-motion policy.
requirements.test_plan: Test SC1.2.1/1.2.2/1.2.3/1.2.5/1.4.2/2.2.2 as applicable; verify actual media and muted/no-media/offline states.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Complete pages and complete processes meet all applicable A/AA criteria.
requirements.implementation_plan: Create a criterion-by-criterion applicability matrix for all templates/states and full flows; evaluate names/language/landmarks, bypass blocks, headings, help and noninterference as well as listed priorities.
requirements.test_plan: Automated scan plus manual keyboard/readers on full page and complete process; record each applicable A/AA criterion, exceptions and evidence.
requirements.gap: Selected checks and an axe score alone do not constitute WCAG2.2AA conformance.

requirements.requirement: Determine the actual legal and market scope and edition.
requirements.implementation_plan: Record B2C electronic-commerce/service status, entity/market role, service dates and any evidenced microenterprise exception; separately check relevant Official Journal harmonisation.
requirements.test_plan: Qualified reviewer signs scope record and exact applicable standard editions; do not infer EAA presumption from a public-sector WAD reference.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: If in scope, accessible service information, support and commerce/auth flows are included.
requirements.implementation_plan: Map BFSG14 and applicable BFSGV12/19 obligations to real product information, help, identification/auth/security/payment steps and downloadable documents.
requirements.test_plan: Review actual information and support channels plus complete relevant processes; verify omissions before release.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: A quality system has a defined scope, responsibilities and controlled evidence.
requirements.implementation_plan: Version policies/objectives, process owners, competence and supplier/release responsibilities; resolve2015+Amd2024 versus2026 transition.
requirements.test_plan: Management review of documented scope and sampled controlled change records; licensed-clause review if conformity sought.
requirements.gap: CI and repository process files are only technical inputs, not an audited QMS.

requirements.requirement: Defects drive corrective action and actual improvement.
requirements.implementation_plan: Record incident/complaint/nonconformity, cause, owner, correction, effectiveness review and unresolved risks; maintain audit/management review evidence.
requirements.test_plan: Sample completed correction cycles and independent internal audit; external certification only through a chosen competent body.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Risk treatment and security controls match a documented system scope.
requirements.implementation_plan: Inventory assets/data/roles/vendors/threats; document risk treatment and justified applicable controls/SoA, including cloud/CI/identity boundaries.
requirements.test_plan: Independent review of scope, risk/controls and operational evidence; full licensed standard before conformity claim.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Identity isolation, secret handling and production change protections work in deployment.
requirements.implementation_plan: Preserve failclosed tenant/role checks, least privilege, server-only secrets and reviewed releases; isolate visitor/Clerk/API-key identities.
requirements.test_plan: Real negative auth/tenant tests in actual deployed architecture, secret leak probes and reviewed config; do not claim shared-poolRLS from principal-onlySQL tests.
requirements.gap: Local isolated foundations do not establish production identity/RLS/operational controls.

requirements.requirement: Privacy by design/default limits data and exposure.
requirements.implementation_plan: Map visitor identity/chat/booking/outbox/media fields, purpose, legal basis and recipients; minimise payloads; default no mic/provider transfer or public private metadata.
requirements.test_plan: Inspect network/storage and generated bundle; test denied consent and absent session; assess actual necessity and DPIA triggers.
requirements.gap: Public filtering exists; processing/legal-basis/retention completeness is not accepted.

requirements.requirement: Risk-appropriate security includes resilience and restore testing.
requirements.implementation_plan: Define encryption/access control, backup/restore, incident handling and regular security review suited to actual risks.
requirements.test_plan: Perform authorised isolated restore/readback and incident exercise; verify productionTLS, access revocation and logs without secrets.
requirements.gap: Static artifact integrity is not a restore test for accounts, conversations, keys or provider services.

requirements.requirement: Retention, deletion and processor/transfer contracts are real decisions.
requirements.implementation_plan: Define periods and deletion/hold rules for visitor messages/bookings/outbox and media; verify provider region/AVV/SCC/subprocessors where relevant. Do not invent periods.
requirements.test_plan: Expired/erasure/hold tests, deletion receipts and contract review; include backups and provider copies within agreed policy.
requirements.gap: Visitorexpiry alone does not delete stored personal records; no complete retention job/contract evidence.

requirements.requirement: Actual AI interaction is disclosed accurately at first relevant interaction.
requirements.implementation_plan: Classify structured deterministic assistant versus actual generative/provider system; introduce clear accessible context-specific disclosure when applicable without claiming a model is connected prematurely.
requirements.test_plan: Inspect first visit and restored session with keyboard/reader; verify actual backend capabilities and provider/deployer role.
requirements.gap: No acceptance evidence for the current source-faithful rebuild.

requirements.requirement: Synthetic presenter/media transparency and output marking are version-bound.
requirements.implementation_plan: Track rights and synthetic/deepfake classification; accessible disclosure by first exposure; assess provider machine-readable marking duties separately from deployer notice.
requirements.test_plan: Read actual media metadata/watermark/marking and UI notice against selected version; no media delivered means no successful marking test.
requirements.gap: No actual provider-generated media or machine-readable marking validated by this task.

release_gate.acceptance_rule: Every applicable requirement needs scope decision, implementation, executed test, inspectable evidence, owner review and resolved blocking findings for the exact release. No implicit pass from file existence.

edition_limitations: DIN national catalogue statuses observed; international ISO publication/supersession lifecycle not directly verified because ISO access returned403. Confirm exact applicable edition and transition before conformity claims.
